name: mx-lounge
description: The Lounge design language of @motifx-community/design-system: the shared primitives, Lounge's own scales, its dark theme and its densities. Same token names as the default language (mx.resolver.json), different values. Design Tokens Resolver Module 2025.10.

primitive.description: Shared palette and scales, the same in every design language.

designLanguage.description: Lounge's corner radii, shadows, type and motion.

theme.description: Semantic colors and the focus ring. Lounge ships a dark theme only.

density.description: Control heights, paddings, gaps and the pressable feel.
